verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a root llms.txt at docs.snowflake.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a proper summary header. Snowflake also publishes section-scoped llms.txt files for Snowpark, Streamlit and Snowflake Postgres, so an agent can be pointed at either the full docs index or a focused product area. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents successfully consuming these files, and evidence of other agent-oriented doc formats (e.g., per-page markdown or llms-full.txt).
